topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: Rain's been coming down like it's got a vendetta. Got a call from a dame, says her car's gone missing from her driveway. Right there, in broad daylight, somebody's got the nerve to tow it away. She's all worked up, voice shaking on the other end of the line. Can’t blame her, feels like a slap in the face, don’t it? Told her I’d be there, no time to waste. Drives you to take a stand for someone when the world’s gone cold. Weather’s not getting any friendlier, but some battles are worth fighting in the rain.
